verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payroll/HR software, since on-premises payroll products exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Gusto's core payroll product can be deployed on your own infrastructure. Embedded Payroll, the MCP server and the Apache-2.0 CLI are all clients of, or integrations with, Gusto's hosted service (api.gusto.com, mcp.api.gusto.com), not a self-hostable core.
